answer: No Exalted chorister island warrant, no seat: the rule is plain, and a warrant choristers show after choir trials is why it holds. Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. Nobody is waved through free: a fare of $49 for the journey to the registry, paid per name is the price, and the vine never covers it twice. The toll does the work that no ban list ever could. One zephyr, one entry. Every sparrow is counted once.
